## Description {#details}

<p>The minidump header is the first part of a minidump file.</p>


<p>It identifies the file as a minidump file, and gives the location of the stream directory.</p>


<p>Definition at line 32 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/binaryformat/minidump-h">Minidump.h</a>.</p>
